question: Sir Garfield Sobers Trophy is related to which of the following sports events?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cricket**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Sir Garfield Sobers Trophy** is awarded annually by the International Cricket Council (ICC) to the best male cricketer in the world.
 
• This prestigious award is named after Sir Garfield Sobers, a legendary West Indian cricketer known for his exceptional all-round abilities.
 
• It recognizes outstanding performance in all formats of the game over the period of the award.
 
• The award is part of the ICC Awards, which also include various other categories for recognizing excellence in cricket.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Sir Garfield Sobers, after whom the trophy is named, is widely regarded as one of the greatest cricketers of all time.
 
• The ICC Awards were established in 2004 to celebrate the best international cricket players and their achievements.
 
• The awards are decided by an independent voting academy comprising former players, match officials, media representatives, and other prominent figures in the cricketing world.
 
• Previous winners of the Sir Garfield Sobers Trophy include cricket legends like Sachin Tendulkar, Ricky Ponting, and Virat Kohli.
